jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV - Sustainability
jobs.description:
**Position Description**:  
  
The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD).  
  
Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.  
  
The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding. Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate. Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification.
* Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes.
* Familiarity with Division of the State Architect (DSA) design and construction processe

Tier 1 to the world’s leading industry manufacturers, Latecoere serves aerospace with innovative solutions for a sustainable world. The Group operates in all segments of the aerospace industry (commercial, regional, business, defense and space) in two business areas: Aerostructures (doors, fuselage, wings and empennage, struts & rods) and Interconnection Systems (wiring, avionic racks, onboard equipment, electronic systems).

Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this role is responsible for coordinating program activities, maintaining schedules and documentation, tracking deliverables, and facilitating communication across departments to ensure customer commitments are met on time and within scope.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoys working cross-functionally, and possesses strong project coordination and communication skills.

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through
* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Salary Range:** **$26.00 - $28.00/ Hourly**

SUMMARY: This role provides coordination and administrative support to the trade marketing team, serving as the central coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by Marketing. Positioned between the marketing and sales functions, the Trade Marketing Coordinator manages trade plan requests in Asana, tracks and reconciles invoices against approved plans, and ensures marketing collateral and deliverables reach the sales team on time. Working closely with marketing and sales team members, this role helps integrate trade and direct marketing plans so both teams stay aligned, informed, and on schedule.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Serve as the coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by the Marketing team, maintaining plan details, timelines, budgets, and deliverables in a central, up-to-date view.
* Support incoming Asana requests related to trade plans, helping confirm briefs are complete, due dates are clear, and tasks reach the appropriate team members.
* Track and compare trade partner and vendor invoices against approved trade plans, flagging discrepancies, overages, or undelivered items and following up with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Ensure marketing collateral and deliverables are shared with the sales team on time, coordinating deadlines and communicating updates or changes as they arise.
* Support the integration of trade and direct marketing plans, helping align timing, offers, and messaging across channels so the two plans work together.
* Review trade and sales-facing marketing materials, including approach guides, the travel advisor portal, and sales and consortia materials, flagging outdated, inaccurate, or off-brand content for the appropriate owners and making minor corrections where appropriate.
* Act as a day-to-day liaison between Marketing and Sales on trade plan status, questions, and requested updates, tracking them through to completion.
* Support trade shows, sales events, and partner programs as needed, including logistics, materials, vendor communication, and attendee coordination.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and meeting notes to provide visibility into trade plan progress, planned versus actual spend, and team priorities.
* Maintain project documentation, workflows, templates, and process guides to support consistent trade plan management across Marketing and Sales.
* Provide general administrative support to the Marketing team as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

COMPETENCIES: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the

following competencies:

* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
* Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.
* Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that

must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform

essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to walk, stoop,

kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee is frequently required to stand, reach with hands and arms. The employee is continually required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel; talk or hear.

The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 45 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and color vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are

representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, monitoring, tracking, and documenting all inbound, outbound, and interfacility logistics activities at PureTek Corporation. This position ensures the timely, accurate, cost-effective, and compliant movement of raw materials, packaging components, equipment, supplies, work-in-process materials, and finished products among PureTek's manufacturing facilities, suppliers, customers, warehouses, and third-party logistics providers. Serving as the central point of contact for shipment activities, the Logistics Coordinator maintains end-to-end visibility of transportation schedules, shipment status, delivery performance, documentation, and logistics-related issues. The position works closely with Purchasing, Planning, Warehouse, Production, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Customer Service, and external transportation providers to support operational efficiency and compliance with company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Inbound, Outbound, and Interfacility Logistics**

* Coordinate and monitor incoming shipments of raw materials, packaging components, equipment, supplies, and other purchased materials, as well as outbound shipments of finished goods to customers, distributors, warehouses, and designated destinations.
* Coordinate transportation and material transfers between PureTek's Nelson and Arroyo manufacturing facilities, including raw materials, packaging components, bulk products, work-in-process materials, and finished goods.
* Communicate with suppliers, Purchasing, freight carriers, Warehouse, Planning, Production, Quality Assurance, and Customer Service to confirm shipment schedules, material availability, shipment readiness, delivery requirements, and expected delivery dates.
* Arrange transportation through approved carriers and third-party logistics providers, coordinating pickup, transit, delivery, and receiving schedules to minimize delays, congestion, and operational disruptions.
* Ensure outbound products have the required QA release or documented authorization before dispatch.
* Monitor shipments from supplier dispatch or facility departure through final delivery, identifying and resolving delays, shortages, damages, quantity discrepancies, missed pickups, and delivery exceptions.
* Obtain and maintain required shipping and transfer documentation, including packing lists, bills of lading, certificates, proof of delivery (POD), material identification, lot information when applicable, and traceability records.
* Ensure interfacility transfers are properly documented in applicable inventory management systems and investigate discrepancies between dispatched and received quantities.
* Provide timely shipment status updates to internal departments and authorized customers.

**B. Shipment Tracking, Inventory, and Warehouse Coordination**

* Establish and maintain a centralized logistics tracking system covering all inbound, outbound, and interfacility shipments, monitoring open shipments through final delivery confirmation and resolution of outstanding issues.
* Maintain accurate shipment records, including shipment reference numbers, suppliers or customers, product/material descriptions, carriers and tracking information, origins and destinations, scheduled pickup dates, expected and actual delivery dates, shipment status, transportation costs, exceptions, and corrective actions.
* Monitor shipment status daily, including pending receipts, outstanding deliveries, unconfirmed shipments, and transportation exceptions; provide daily updates and escalate issues that may affect manufacturing schedules, customer commitments, or product quality.
* Coordinate shipment priorities with Warehouse, Planning, and Production based on production schedules, customer requirements, and material availability.
* Verify shipment quantities and product identification against applicable shipping documents and coordinate loading, unloading, staging, and shipment preparation with warehouse personnel.
* Support inventory reconciliation for materials in transit and report logistics-related inventory discrepancies to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain shipment records and supporting documentation in accordance with company procedures.

**C. Transportation and Freight Management**

* Coordinate freight arrangements with approved transportation companies, couriers, and third-party logistics providers; obtain and compare freight quotations to identify cost-effective transportation options.
* Monitor freight charges, verify invoices against approved quotations, shipment records, and applicable contractual rates, and identify opportunities to reduce transportation costs.
* Coordinate special transportation requirements, including temperature-controlled shipments when applicable, and expedited shipments when necessary, obtaining required management approval.
* Monitor carrier performance, including pickup reliability, transit times, delivery accuracy, and damage rates; support transportation provider evaluations and recommend improvements in logistics efficiency.
* Evaluate opportunities to consolidate interfacility transfers and reduce unnecessary transportation expenses.

**D. Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable PureTek SOPs, GMP requirements, distribution procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance regarding shipment release status, damaged materials, transportation excursions, and other quality-related concerns. Ensure quarantined, rejected, or restricted materials are not shipped without appropriate authorization.
* Support product traceability by maintaining accurate shipping, receiving, transfer, and lot records, as applicable.
* Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance regarding applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements.

jobs.description:
The California Health Care Safety Net Institute (SNI) partners with California’s public health care systems to optimize and transform the ecosystem of care, providing high-quality, patient-led, and equitable care for all. Together with our advocacy partner, the California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems, SNI works to strengthen care delivery systems by shaping the policies and programs that drive improvement and creating a community where system leaders can exchange ideas and advance shared priorities.

SNI and CAPH represent California’s 17 public health care systems, which include the county-owned or affiliated systems and the University of California academic medical centers. These systems serve as the foundation of the state’s safety net, delivering care to all who need it, regardless of insurance coverage, immigration status, ability to pay, or other circumstances. Public health care systems primarily serve people from historically marginalized communities, including persons of color, individuals experiencing financial hardship or homelessness, and individuals with complex health and social needs.

Although SNI and CAPH are separate legal entities, they function day-to-day as a matrix organization, with SNI contributing to CAPH’s policy and advocacy efforts, CAPH offering technical expertise to SNI’s programs, and the organizations working together to achieve shared goals for our member systems.

SNI and CAPH are committed to advancing equity and serve as an Equal Opportunity Employer with a strong commitment to racial, cultural, and ethnic diversity. Qualified applicants of all races, people with all abilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

**SNI’s Programs**

SNI brings together systems’ leaders from clinical, quality, data, finance, and operational areas through in-person and virtual convenings, communities of practice, webinars, and our CAPH/SNI Annual Conference. By creating a community where leaders can exchange ideas and problem-solve, SNI helps systems work through complex issues and apply successful strategies from peers in their own settings.

Beyond these convenings, SNI creates practical resources and content to surface and share what is working across the field. These include lessons learned briefs, roadmaps, case studies, and articles drawn from member systems’ experiences.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

The Program Coordinator plays an essential support role in planning and implementing SNI’s programs. Working closely with SNI and CAPH staff, the Coordinator will:

· Support the design and delivery of in-person and virtual learning events for health system leaders across SNI’s program areas (e.g., protecting Medicaid coverage and access, strengthening health equity, improving cost effectiveness and efficiency).

o Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, including developing and managing workplans, scheduling speaker prep calls, creating and administering pre-event surveys and post-event evaluations, and providing day-of support during events, among other duties.

o Work with the program team, particularly the team lead, to identify systems’ needs and develop program content and materials.

· Lead the Quality Leaders Awards ceremony and luncheon during CAPH/SNI’s Annual Conference.

o Prepare and disseminate the call for applications and organize submissions.

o Coordinate the judging process by helping to identify external judges, scheduling judging calls, and reviewing and scoring submissions with the judges’ panel.

o Oversee the awards ceremony and luncheon at the annual conference, including serving as the point of contact for awardees, preparing the SNI Board Chair to moderate, and managing all aspects of the day-of event, among other duties.

o Additionally, support the annual conference team in identifying and preparing conference speakers.

· Perform administrative duties, such as scheduling meetings, summarizing meeting notes, and printing and compiling meeting materials.

· Complete other duties and projects as needed.

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a health-related field, or commensurate experience.

· Minimum of 1 year of work experience, which may include internships and fellowships. Experience working in a health care setting and/or public agency a plus.

· Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a timely, organized manner with .

· Strong writing and editing skills. Adept at translating complex information into accessible language for a variety of audiences.

· Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Zoom. Preferred experience working with WordPress, Constant Contact, and/or online collaborative tools, such as Miro.

· Comfortable using AI tools to improve work quality and productivity while exercising independent thinking and ownership of final work.

· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to interact professionally and courteously with health system leadership, consultants, and peers.

· Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn on the fly, and work effectively in teams, as well as independently.

· Understanding of California’s health care landscape, particularly programs that serve Medicaid and uninsured patients, a plus.

**Work Environment**

CAPH/SNI operates in a hybrid work environment, with two required in-person days (Monday and Wednesday) at the office in Oakland, CA for those living 40 miles or less from the office; one required in-person day (Monday) for those living farther away. The remaining days are conducted remotely.

This role requires occasional in-state travel, including overnight travel for in-person convenings and the annual conference.

The starting salary range for this position is $65,000-$75,000. SNI offers an extremely competitive benefits package, as well as opportunities to attend professional conferences and participate in professional development trainings.

jobs.description:
**Nature of Position**
----------------------

**THE POSITION**

The City of Alameda is seeking to fill a **Program Specialist II** position **to administer the City's Clean Water Program activities.** Under direction, Program Specialist II's perform a variety of detailed, specialized program work in public infrastructure management, community development, environmental compliance and/or other designated areas; and perform other related work as required. Positions assigned to this classification are expected to perform varied assignments requiring technical and interpersonal skill in assigned program areas. Work in the class is distinguished from that of the Program Specialist I by the greater complexity of the assignments received and by the greater independence with which the incumbent is expected to operate. This position prepares reports, makes recommendations, and performs monitoring activities. Support is available for problems not covered by reference guidelines, and work is checked occasionally during progress and reviewed upon completion.
  
  
**CURRENT VACANCY**
  
The current vacancy is in the **Environmental Services Division** of the **Public Works Department** and will be **assigned to the City's Clean Water Program** which ensures compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates associated with stormwater runoff and water quality. Through the implementation of its Clean Water Program, the City of Alameda is committed to performing appropriate municipal services and to providing Alameda residents and businesses practical solutions to help reduce stormwater pollution. The Clean Water Program uses a multi-faceted approach to prevent stormwater pollution including: street sweeping; public outreach and education; new development design review; industrial and commercial facility inspections; construction site inspections; illicit discharge inspections and response/enforcement; trash load reduction; heavy metals and legacy pollutant controls; storm drain system cleaning and maintenance; storm drain system improvements and upgrades (e.g. pump stations, storm mains); participation in the Alameda County Clean Water Program; and contributes to a regional water quality monitoring program. We are seeking someone with specialized knowledge and experience administering similar program elements and working with the public to reduce stormwater pollution.

  

**THE COMMUNITY**

The City of Alameda is a unique island community of approximately 80,000 residents in the San Francisco Bay Area. It is connected to the East Bay mainland by four bridges, two underwater tubes, and by ferry services to San Francisco. Alameda is within minutes of the numerous cultural activities in San Francisco, Oakland and Berkeley. A vibrant community with a rich history and small-town charm, Alameda has a diverse mix of housing, neighborhoods, and pedestrian friendly shopping areas. Charming Victorian homes grace shady tree-lined streets covering the island's 23 square miles.

The City is a full-service organization providing residents with a broad range of municipal services including police and fire protection; construction and maintenance of streets, sewers, storm drains, street lights, and other infrastructure; a state-of-the-art library system; and over 400 acres of parks and recreational facilities including multi-use athletic fields, picnic sites, a skate park, a swim center, and a full service senior center. The City owns and operates Alameda Municipal Power, an electric utility serving the needs of all Alameda residents and businesses. Visit the City of Alameda website at: www.alamedaca.gov

  

**THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT**
  
The City of Alameda Public Works Department is the steward of Alameda's public infrastructure, responsible for its design, construction, and maintenance. The Department's Five-Year Strategic Plan organizes the department's work into four key focus areas: Resilient Workforce, Sustainable Funding, Reliable Infrastructure, and Effective Service Delivery. Operationally, the Public Works Department is working to be the best organization in the San Francisco Bay Area with focus on making strides to be at the forefront of Public Works best practices, investing in robust GIS, asset management, permitting, finance systems and much more. Come and join our dynamic team to be an integral part of this vision!

---------------------------

* **Dental:** Comprehensive dental coverage provided to employees and their eligible dependents.
* **Vacation:** Starting with 75 hours annually and increasing with years of service.
* **Holidays:** 11 City Holidays and 4 floating Holidays.
* **Sick Leave:** 90 hours annually; unused sick leave is converted to service credit at retirement.

**Examples of Duties**

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. This role sits on a new, first-of-its-kind team focused on automation, transformation, and scaled engagment — building the systems, workflows, and reporting infrastructure that will transform partner account management to scale efficiently.

We are looking for a collaborative, analytical builder with a passion for problem-solving at scale to join our newly formed ISV Digital team within the ISV Partnerships organization. This role sits at the intersection of new partner enablement, lifecycle marketing, and systems automation. * 5+ years of work experience in sales or partner account management, or partner success.
* Experience managing high-volume of accounts, and implementing scaled approaches.
* Experience building automation and workflows using agentic tools.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, and proficiency segmenting and analyzing data within Excel/Google Sheets.

* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. * Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management

* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

We’re looking for someone who communicates clearly, follows through, manages competing deadlines, and cares about both accuracy and presentation.

You'll also have the opportunity to collaborate with and learn from fellow marketing professionals within our company and take on greater responsibility as your experience grows. * Coordinate the receipt of necessary information from internal clients, external consultants, and other team members to include in proposal and presentation materials

jobs.description:
**About PhoenixAI**

PhoenixAI is the Agentic AI Database, purpose-built to give autonomous AI agents sub-second access to live enterprise data at massive scale. The platform unifies real-time and at-rest data in a single AI-native engine, combining the speed and concurrency that agentic workloads demand with the governance and deployment flexibility enterprises require to put AI into production. Formerly known as CelerData, PhoenixAI is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Learn more at phoenixdata.ai

**About the role**

We’re looking for two highly motivated Sales Development Representatives (SDR) to join our growing GTM team and help drive adoption of our Agentic AI Database.

As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact for many of our prospects. You’ll play a critical role in building pipeline, identifying qualified opportunities, and partnering closely with Account Executives (AEs) to accelerate PhoenixAI’s growth across global markets.

This role is ideal for someone who is curious about data, AI, and cloud technologies, enjoys engaging with people, and wants to develop a long-term career in enterprise sales.

**What you'll do**

* Research, identify, and prospect target accounts through outbound channels (email, LinkedIn, calls, events).
* Respond to and qualify inbound leads generated from marketing campaigns, webinars, Slack channels, and events.
* Conduct initial discovery calls to assess prospect needs and fit using frameworks MEDDIC.
* Book and manage high-quality meetings or demos for the AE team.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospect interactions in Salesforce (or equivalent CRM).
* Collaborate with marketing to refine messaging and feedback from the field.
* Achieve and exceed weekly/monthly KPIs (e.g., qualified opportunities, meetings booked, conversion rate).
* Stay informed about PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database product capabilities, competitive landscape, and industry trends.

**Qualifications**

* Hunter mindset, you are always hungry for new businesses.
* 1–3 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, AI, or data infrastructure.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable engaging with technical and business audiences.
* Self-motivated, organized, and eager to learn in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Familiarity with CRM and outreach tools (ZoomInfo, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
* Interest in AI, data, cloud, or analytics technologies is a strong plus.

The base salary range for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area is $58,000 - $75,000 annually, and the OTE is projected at $82,857 - $107,143 annually. The offer also includes PhoenixAI's full benefits package. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, scope, and interview results.

*PhoenixAI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $58K - $75K

jobs.title: Commercial Sales Representative
jobs.description:
American Window Film is seeking a high-performing Commercial Sales Representative to drive revenue growth within an assigned metro territory. This is a strategic outside sales role focused on delivering exceptional customer service to generate repeat business, winning large commercial projects, and expanding and developing a strong commercial client base.

The ideal candidate understands the construction sales cycle, can read architectural plans, and is comfortable working with General Contractors, Glass Companies, Property Managers, and Facilities professionals.

**Job Responsibilities**

Territory & Business Development

* Develop and execute a territory sales plan to achieve revenue and margin targets
* Prospect and cultivate new commercial relationships within the assigned metro area
* Build strategic relationships with General Contractors, Glass & Glazing Companies, Commercial Property Management Firms, Facilities Management Professionals, and Building Owners & Developers
* Actively network within the local construction and commercial real estate community

Project & Sales Process Management

* Manage a proactive sales process from prospecting to close and project turnover
* Conduct site visits, take field measurements, and collaborate with estimating
* Review architectural plans and specifications as needed
* Develop and present detailed proposals tailored to client needs
* Negotiate pricing and scope while protecting company margin standards
* Close large-scale commercial projects

Customer Experience & Account Management

* Provide a high level of service to build long-term repeat relationships
* Maintain consistent communication throughout estimating, scheduling, and installation
* Proactively resolve issues to ensure customer satisfaction
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts

Performance & Reporting

* Maintain accurate CRM activity and pipeline management
* Track and report key metrics: $ Installed Revenue, $ Estimated / Pipeline Volume, Close Ratio vs. Targets, Margin Performance
* Participate in weekly sales meetings and forecasting reviews

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of outside sales experience
* Proven ability to win and manage large commercial projects
* Experience working within the construction or commercial building industry
* Strong relationship-building and networking skills
* Self-motivated with strong territory management discipline
* Must have a valid Driver’s License and a clean Driver’s Record to drive company vehicle

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with window film, glazing, glass, or related building envelope products
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications
* Experience selling to General Contractors or Property Management firms
* CRM proficiency

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Prospecting
* Relationship-Driven Selling
* Consultative Sales Approach
* Project Management Mindset
* Financial & Margin Awareness
* Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills
* High Accountability to Metrics

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive monthly commission program
* Flexible Schedule: Work day is spent on the road and/or in office
* Paid Time Off plan for full time employees
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and more \*For eligible employees
* 401(k): American Window Film will match 3% of what you contribute

American Window Film Perks:

* Family & Friends Day - take an extra day off and get $300 to spend time with family and friends.
* People Helping People - take an extra day off to help someone out or contribute to a worthy cause
* Fitness, Health and Wellness allowance - get $250 towards any health and wellness activity
* We not me time - get $300 when you spend time with a co-worker outside of work
* perks subject to terms and conditions and may change at any time

PAY RANGE:

* Base Salary: $80,000/yr + 4% monthly commission
* OTE: $140,000-$160,000+/yr

**Our Core Values**

* Create Loyal fans - We create an environment that people love
* Authenticity Matters - Trust is built one job at a time
* Be Excellent Together - We support our teammates
* We Embrace Change - How we got here today is not how we will get there tomorrow

**Physical Demands**

* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
* Ability to drive a company work vehicle
* Must have a valid Driver’s License

*American Window Film provides equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, disability, as well as any other protected status under the law.*

The Eames Institute of Infinite Curiosity is a nonprofit public charity dedicated to advancing the dynamic legacy of 20th-century designers Ray and Charles Eames. By sharing the things the Eameses made and loved, along with their joyful and rigorous approach to life and work, we seek to inspire creative problem-solving that positively shapes our world.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. RIS uses a data-driven approach to design and implement street safety redesign projects, administer safety programs, promote senior and youth safety, manage crash data and data applications, conduct large-scale safety research projects, and lead agency action plans related to safety and Vision Zero programs/policy.
  
  
RIS’ Safety Projects and Programs team is seeking candidates for a Project Coordinator position. The candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, conducting outreach, and implementing Street Improvement Projects to improve safety for pedestrians, motor vehicles, bicyclists, transit riders, and motorcyclists, with a focus on the goals of the Streets Plan and Vision Zero. The position will focus on incorporating proven safety treatments to improve safety for all users as part of DOT’s commitment to Vision Zero and improving the safety, reliability, and accessibility of transit corridors.
  
  
Key tasks for this position include performing research and crash analysis to identify high crash locations, scoping and designing safety improvement projects for high crash locations, analyzing traffic data, preparing reports/graphics and maps, conducting field work including on-site evaluations and field meetings, coordinating project implementation, and providing technical assistance to senior staff. development of housing, transportation, environmental, and city-owned land planning projects; or

However, all candidates must have a baccalaureate degree.

Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills a must. Valid NYS Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. RIS uses a data-driven approach to design and implement street safety redesign projects, administer safety programs, promote senior and youth safety, manage crash data and data applications, conduct large-scale safety research projects, and lead agency action plans related to safety and Vision Zero programs/policy.
  
  
RIS’ Safety Projects and Programs team is seeking candidates for a Project Coordinator position. The candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, conducting outreach, and implementing Street Improvement Projects to improve safety for pedestrians, motor vehicles, bicyclists, transit riders, and motorcyclists, with a focus on the goals of the Streets Plan and Vision Zero. The position will focus on incorporating proven safety treatments to improve safety for all users as part of DOT’s commitment to Vision Zero and improving the safety, reliability, and accessibility of transit corridors.
  
  
Key tasks for this position include performing research and crash analysis to identify high crash locations, scoping and designing safety improvement projects for high crash locations, analyzing traffic data, preparing reports/graphics and maps, conducting field work including on-site evaluations and field meetings, coordinating project implementation, and providing technical assistance to senior staff. The selected candidates will also be required to participate in community outreach, including developing outreach plans and materials meetings with public officials, Community Boards, and inter- and intra-agency stakeholders. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, a capable team player, and possess excellent communication skills. This is an opportunity to work with a team dedicated to improving safety, accessibility, and mobility throughout New York City.
  
  
TRANSPORTATION SPECIALIST - 22316

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master's degree in transportation engineering, mathematics, urban planning, architecture, landscape architecture, urban studies, or related physical and social science fields; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree in engineering from an accredited college and one year of full-time satisfactory experience performing technical work on roadway transportation and traffic studies and area-wide traffic programs; or
  
  
3. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
4. An associate degree or completion of 60 semester credits from an accredited college and four years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
5. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and six years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above.
  
  
SPECIAL NOTE:
  
  
In addition to meeting the minimum Qualification Requirements above:
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level II, the candidate must have an additional year of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level III, the candidate must have an additional two years of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
The preferred candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe Creative Suite. Experience in AutoCAD, GIS, and traffic engineering software is a plus. Knowledge of traffic calming, urban design, pedestrian-oriented design, complete streets, and traffic engineering is preferred... Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills preferred. Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintained throughout the duration of employment in this position.
  

**55a Program**

jobs.description:
**Careers at Keel**

Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America.

At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute.

  

**Why Keel**

We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time.

The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real.

You'll be part of a team that values:

* **Ownership**— we take responsibility and follow through
* **Collaboration**— we work across teams, functions, and borders
* **Curiosity**— we ask questions and keep learning
* **Endurance**— we build for the long term

  

**What It Feels Like to Work Here**

* Fast-moving, high-growth, and hands-on
* Smart, driven people solving real challenges together
* Work that directly supports AI and next-generation infrastructure
* Room to grow, stretch, and take on more

  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
* Retirement savings with company contribution
* Employee referral program

  

We are currently looking for a **Program Coordinator** to join our team

  

**Role Summary**

Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Program Coordinator in Program Delivery to manage the team's internal process and maintain the source of truth for program governance and strategy. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Program Delivery, this role keeps documentation and process organized across the design and construction of HPC data center facilities, so each group has what it needs to project success.

This is an entry-level / early-career role. The Program Coordinator works closely with the Customer Success Manager, Pre-Construction Director, Leasing and Corp Dev, Design, Project Controls, Procurement, Construction, and Operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Governance and Strategy:** Maintain and keep organized company documentation, procedures, and process to support program-level planning and execution across engineering, controls, and construction.
* **Program Health:** Schedule and run the internal program meeting cadence; prepare agendas, capture minutes, track actions to closure, and flag blockers early.
* **Process Coordination:** Coordinate the team's process across groups; track that both handoffs (tenant requirements and site) are complete and received, and keep each handoff documented and on track. Identify routine tasks that can be standardized or automated, and propose improvements using AI.
* **Trackers:** Maintain program trackers, including action items, decisions, risks, the change log, design review comments, and open items; track milestone adherence and flag early-warning deviations to the managers.
* **Reporting Inputs:** Compile weekly and monthly status inputs from the team and partners; prepare drafts of internal reports and tenant reports for the Customer Success Manager and VP of Data Center Program Delivery.
* **Documentation:** Maintain organized program documentation and folder structure so the current version of any key document is easy to find. Manage commissioning and turnover documentation for the Customer Success Manager and the VP of Data Center Program Delivery.
* **Portfolio Dashboards and KPIs:** Build and maintain portfolio-level dashboards and KPI reporting (cost, schedule, risk, capital efficiency) for the VP to present; implement integrated reporting tools and workflows (such as Procore, P6, Smartsheet, Power BI, SharePoint) with Project Controls.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or a similar role.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail; proficient in MS Suite and project management software, including but not limited to Procore, BIM 360/ACC, and SharePoint.
* Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Design engineering or construction experience in data center, mission critical, or life science environments.
* CAPM or similar credential.

**Success Measures**

* Trackers, dashboards, and reports are accurate, current, and used by the team on an established cadence.
* Handoffs between groups are documented, with no gaps for partner teams to commence their work streams.
* Meetings produce documented decisions and actions with owners and dates.
* Managers spend less time chasing information, and the source of truth is organized.

**Work Environment:**

* Location: New York Office
* Schedule: On-site a minimum of three (3) days per week.
* Travel: Periodic travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and partner locations as required.

The base salary range is $95,000-$110,000. Our total compensation package combines this base salary with a bonus target and participates in our yearly equity grant. We offer a fantastic benefits package and many perks. There's a top-down emphasis on amazing work culture at our organization.

jobs.description:
**LOCATION**

DOROT is headquartered on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, and staff works on a hybrid schedule. The Program Coordinator of Learning, Culture & Community oversees the implementation of many in-person programs and is expected to work in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

  

**ABOUT DOROT**

Founded in 1976, DOROT (“generations” in Hebrew) facilitates a dynamic partnership between older adults, volunteers, and professionals through programs designed to combat social isolation and loneliness and bring the generations together. DOROT is dedicated to enhancing the lives of older adults to help them live more independently as valued community members. Compassion and commitment to excellence are hallmarks of DOROT’s programs and staff. The agency is a recognized innovative leader in mobilizing volunteers and infusing social work into its service delivery model. Our programs are conducted onsite, in the home, remotely and in the community.

**ABOUT THE** **LEARNING, CULTURE & COMMUNITY DEPARTMENT**

DOROT believes that community is not something people simply belong to – it is something people build together, one gathering at a time. The Learning, Culture & Community team annually engages over 4,500 adults aged 60 to 100+ by developing classes, workshops, cultural events, social gatherings, and other programs that build relationships and community. Offered in person, online via Zoom, and over the telephone, our peer group programs promote lifelong learning, health and wellness, creative expression, and meaningful social connection.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting the Manager of Learning, Culture & Community, the Program Coordinator, Learning, Culture & Community will serve as a proactive, creative, and collaborative member of the Learning, Culture & Community team, performing a combination of programmatic, educational and administrative responsibilities. The Coordinator will contribute to the achievement of program and constituent goals through the development and implementation of in-person and virtual programs that bring people together for conversation, celebration, recreation, and shared cultural experiences. The successful candidate will bring warmth, initiative, and genuine curiosity in older adults and their stories, recognizing participants as contributors to a vibrant community.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a proactive and collaborative member of the Learning, Culture & Community team, contributing to the achievement of program and constituent goals.
* Design, plan, and execute group program experiences that encourage interaction and participation, strengthen connections among participants, and foster an enduring sense of belonging. This includes structured and facilitated programs as well as informal opportunities for connection in the following areas:
  + Community-building programs, including facilitated discussion groups, interactive group experiences, and gatherings that cultivate meaningful relationships over time.
  + Art and cultural programming, including performances, educational experiences, and institutional partnerships that inspire creativity, exploration, and lifelong learning.
  + Gatherings around national and Jewish holidays, seasonal transitions, and other meaningful occasions that make room for celebration, memory, reflection, and companionship.
* Manage all aspects of program coordination, from concept through implementation and follow-up, including presenter and participation communication, room and technology needs, registration oversight and attendance tracking, and production of program specific materials.

* Cultivate**,** maintain, and deepen relationships with a wide array of facilitators, artists, performers, volunteers, and cultural and community organizations; coach and support them in developing programs and gatherings that invite opportunities for connection.
* Strengthen constituent relationships and engagement by gathering feedback, identifying needs and interests, and translating them into opportunities for connection within the broader DOROT community.

* Collaborate with other DOROT departments to support constituent needs and strengthen program planning, including conferring with Supportive Services staff, preparing program data and materials for fundraising proposals and reports, and contributing to targeted marketing and outreach strategies.
* Train, mentor, and oversee office volunteers and interns to ensure best practices and positive experiences for them and participants.
* Collect and enter participation data, constituent interactions, and partner relationships using DOROT’s online database (Salesforce); contribute to the review of statistics for internal reports and analysis of trends.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in community engagement, social services, nonprofit programming, arts and culture, education, health and wellness programming, or a similar field
* Experience in planning, coordinating, or facilitating programs and events for adults required; background in arts and culture, community building, or social programming preferred
* Successful track record of designing inclusive and engaging experiences that foster participation, trust, and belonging amongst participants
* Demonstrated success building and maintaining relationships with facilitators, artists, and partners
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage warmly, professionally, and effectively with people of all ages, including older adults, colleagues, volunteers, presenters, and community partners
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Self-starter who is highly proactive, detail-oriented, flexible, and able to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
* Comfort with public speaking and participant

### **About Nominal**

Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world’s most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We are a fast-moving team that owns problems end to end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software.

We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers including autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI, next-generation aerospace teams such as Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports. We also partner with mission teams within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure is not an option.

  
  

Nominal is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team includes people from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence.

  
  

### **About the role**

Nominal’s Engineering, Product & Design (EPD) org is growing fast, and we’re building a small EPD admin team to support the whole department: its leaders, its recurring meetings, and the way work gets scheduled and coordinated. As our first Administrative Coordinator, you’ll own a defined lane of that work, running day-to-day scheduling and travel for a group of engineering and product leads and keeping EPD’s planning cycles and events on track.

  
  

This role is ideal for someone early in their admin career who loves process and systems and wants to grow alongside a team that’s building something new. You’ll work closely with our admin team lead, who designs the operating model, and you’ll be the one making it run, flagging where it could run better.

  
  

### **What you’ll do:**

* Run scheduling for a group of EPD leads, coordinating cross-team meetings across time zones and shifting priorities within each lead’s set norms.
* Schedule and support EPD’s recurring leadership meetings and quarterly planning cycles so the department’s rhythms stay on track.
* Book travel for EPD leads and coordinate logistics for offsites, team events, and in-office gatherings with our events and operations teams.
* Set up new EPD leads on calendars, recurring meetings, and admin norms during their first weeks.
* Run and refine AI-assisted scheduling and coordination routines, and check their output before it reaches a calendar or an inbox.
* Keep SOPs, templates, and trackers current, and flag repeated friction to the admin team lead with a suggested fix.
* Field admin requests from across EPD, prioritize them against each other, and communicate clearly about timing.
  

  

### **We’re looking for someone with**

* 2+ years of administrative or coordinator experience supporting several people or a team in a high-volume environment (tech preferred).
* Strong calendar skills, including comfort with many attendees, competing priorities, and plans that change.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your work today, with concrete examples, including times you chose not to trust the output.
* A track record of making a process easier for others, such as a template, tracker, or SOP that people kept using.
* Clear, concise writing in email, Slack, and docs that is easy to act on, since much of our team works across offices.
* Discretion with calendars, inboxes, and people matters.
* Professional maturity and a service mindset: at ease with senior leaders, steady when priorities collide, kind but clear about where a request fits, and quick to own mistakes.
  

* **Skills that supercharge us**

* Experience with event logistics such as offsites, co-locations, and team events.
* Experience setting up an AI assistant or automation for others (Claude, Notion AI, Zapier, or similar).
* Experience supporting an engineering or product organization.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Linear, or Ramp.
  

  
  
  

**✨ Benefits/Perks**

* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
* **️** Unlimited PTO and sick leave
* **️** Free lunch, snacks, and coffee
* Professional Development Stipend
* ️ In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend
* **✈️** Annual company retreat
  

  

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.*

  

ITAR Requirements

*To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR* *here**.*

----------------

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Event Operations Manager – Mobile Coffee Catering  
**Full-time | Extensive travel required**

Lead the team. Own the details. Deliver the experience.

Express Kafeh is hiring a hands-on **Event Operations Manager** to lead the execution of our mobile espresso catering services at conventions, trade shows, corporate events, and private functions on the road locally around the country.

Established in 2011, Express Kafeh brings premium coffee experiences to events across the United States and internationally. Our work combines hospitality, equipment, logistics, and teamwork—and every successful event depends on getting the details right.

You will take ownership of assigned events from preparation and equipment readiness through setup, service, breakdown, and final reporting. You must be equally comfortable speaking with a client, directing baristas, checking inventory, loading equipment, and stepping in when something needs fixing.

**This position involves frequent travel, physical work, early mornings, evenings, weekends, and overnight stays.**

What You Will Do

**Prepare each event for success**

* Review event orders, service requirements, schedules, staffing plans, venue instructions, and client expectations.
* Coordinate with our Director of Operations, account managers, warehouse team, and travel coordinator.
* Verify that equipment, supplies, branding, and backup materials are complete, tested, and ready.
* Lead in staging, packing, loading, and inventory checks.
* Confirm access, loading arrangements, power requirements, setup timing, and other essential venue details.
* Identify missing information or potential problems early and follow through until resolved.

**Lead setup and event service**

* Direct in unloading, station setup, equipment testing, and final presentation.
* Brief baristas and support staff on assignments, service standards, schedules, and expectations.
* Ensure every station is clean, properly stocked, operational, and ready before service begins.
* Supervise attendance, appearance, breaks, replenishment, and service performance.
* Maintain a visible presence throughout the event, checking stations and supporting the team.
* Address staffing gaps, equipment problems, supply shortages, and client concerns promptly.
* Step in wherever needed, including assisting with beverage service.
* Follow safety procedures and escalate issues requiring management approval.

**Complete the job properly**

* Lead equipment cleaning, breakdown, packing, loading, and return.
* Reconcile equipment and supplies, documenting missing items, damage, and maintenance needs.
* Verify staff hours and submit required receipts and expense records.
* Complete event reports covering service results, client feedback, staff performance, incidents, and improvements.
* Follow through on outstanding items until the event is fully closed out.

What You Bring

**Required qualifications**

* At least **3 years of relevant experience** in catering, banquets, conventions, event production, hospitality operations, or a comparable hands-on field.
* Experience directly supervising staff in a busy service environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through, including the ability to manage several stations or competing priorities.
* Practical problem-solving skills and confidence handling equipment and learning basic troubleshooting.
* Professional communication and a customer-focused approach.
* Comfort using email, shared calendars, Google Drive, spreadsheets, and digital checklists.
* A valid driver’s license and willingness to drive for company assignments.
* Availability for frequent overnight and multiday travel.
* Flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as event schedules require.
* Ability to perform essential physical duties, including extended standing, loading and unloading, and moving event equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Mobile catering, coffee catering, trade show, or convention experience.
* Barista experience or familiarity with commercial espresso equipment.
* Experience with inventory control, warehouse coordination, freight, or equipment logistics.
* Experience leading temporary staff or teams working together for the first time.
* Experience tracking event expenses and working within an approved budget.

**Coffee experience is a plus. Proven leadership, reliability, and operational judgment are essential.**

How to Apply

Submit your résumé and a brief introduction describing:

* Your experience leading event, hospitality, catering, or operations teams.
* The size and type of events or operations you have managed.
* Your availability for frequent travel.

**We are looking for someone who takes responsibility, supports the team, and follows through from the first equipment check to the final return.**

Pay: $45,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Are you available for frequent overnight and multiday travel, including weekends?
* Describe your personal involvement in event setup, equipment handling, and breakdown.
* Are you able to work in person at our Boca Raton office/warehouse between travel assignments?

License/Certification:

* drivers licence (Required)
