jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

As a Manager of Strategic Account Management at Rippling, you will lead, coach, and scale a team of Account Managers who serve as primary relationship owners for our most Strategic customers. You will drive team strategy, mentor ICs through complex growth and retention opportunities, and foster operational excellence to achieve company targets for customer adoption, net retention, and revenue growth.

**What you will do**

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Careers at Keel**

Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America.

At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute.

  

**Why Keel**

We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time.

The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real.

You'll be part of a team that values:

* **Ownership**— we take responsibility and follow through
* **Collaboration**— we work across teams, functions, and borders
* **Curiosity**— we ask questions and keep learning
* **Endurance**— we build for the long term

  

**What It Feels Like to Work Here**

* Fast-moving, high-growth, and hands-on
* Smart, driven people solving real challenges together
* Work that directly supports AI and next-generation infrastructure
* Room to grow, stretch, and take on more

  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
* Retirement savings with company contribution
* Employee referral program

  

We are currently looking for a **Customer Success Manager** to join our team

  

**Role Summary**

Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Customer Success Manager in Program Delivery to serve as the tenant's day-to-day point of contact and make sure the tenant's needs are captured at intake and delivered through design, construction, and operations handover. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Program Delivery, this role acts as the liaison between the tenant and the development team on behalf of Keel.

The role works closely with Tenants, Leasing and Corp Dev, Pre-Construction, the Program Coordinator, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction Delivery, and Operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Intake with Leasing:** Support Leasing in collecting tenant project requirements and prepare a Tenant Deliverable Package (Basis of Design, specifications, drawings, models, OPRs, reporting standards, delivery strategy, acceptance criteria, schedule expectations, assumptions/constraints).
* **Collaboration with Engineering, Pre-Construction, and Construction:** Maintain the tenant's deliverable package requirements from intake through operational handover as the source of truth for each work stream.
* **Stakeholder Relationship & Reporting:** Own the tenant relationship day to day as single point of contact; run regular touchpoints and action items; prepare tenant-facing reports with Project Controls and the Program Coordinator covering RFIs, schedule, progress, risks, and upcoming decisions.
* **Change Management:** Manage a change control process to receive, log, and route tenant change requests and issues to closure; evaluate scope, cost, and schedule impact with Project Controls; escalate to the VP of DC Program Delivery when a decision or exception is needed.
* **Tenant Expectations:** Ensure metrics and expectation criteria are included to meet tenant milestones through design, construction, and commissioning; obtain approvals and facilitate feedback through design reviews, construction milestones, and tenant handover readiness.
* **Project Close Out:** Deliver a complete close out package with the Program Coordinator; work with Construction to validate punch list items; coordinate with the Director of Quality Assurance / Commissioning and VP of Operations on testing and commissioning requirements.
* **Commercial Awareness:** Deal terms belong to Leasing and Corp Dev; surface commercial questions and misalignment to them early, and address technical, cost, and schedule responses with Engineering and Project Controls.
* **Technical Acumen:** Evaluate technical information from tenants to flag scope gaps or scope creep; understand the flow of data center design and construction phases from concept through completion.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years in a tenant/client-facing role on behalf of a complex mission critical project, providing program management or customer account roles in construction, infrastructure, data center, HPC/AI, or a comparable capital-project environment.
* Working knowledge of construction delivery, schedules, and change management; able to read technical data, drawings, and schedules.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable leading tenant meetings, reporting on project challenges, and determining the correct point to escalate with solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business, sales, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, CAPM, CCM, or similar credential.

  

**Success Measures**

* Tenant requirements are captured at intake and the hand over checklist is received by Engineering and Construction teams at LOI.
* Tenant-driven changes are evaluated for scope, cost, and schedule impacts, with clear impact assessments provided to the tenant.
* Tenant change requests and issues are acknowledged and closed on a tracked timeline aligned with contract and schedule dates.
* Tenant commissioning requirements are delivered and accepted at handover.
* Tenant reports are accurate, on time, and consistent with internal reporting.

**Work Environment:**

* Location: New York Office
* Schedule: On-site a minimum of three (3) days per week.
* Travel: Periodic travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and partner locations as required.

The base salary range is $115,000-$155,000. Our total compensation package combines this base salary with a bonus target and participates in our yearly equity grant. We offer a fantastic benefits package and many perks. There's a top-down emphasis on amazing work culture at our organization.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Logicbroker, Inc.**

Logicbroker is the Agentic Commerce Orchestration Engine helping enterprise retailers, brands, suppliers, and distributors connect and grow. Our Intelligent Commerce Network powers over $10B in GMV for global leaders like Samsung, Walgreens, and Home Depot by automating the entire process from discovery to doorstep and stock to dock. We make products discoverable, shoppable, fulfillable, and returnable so our clients can grow faster, delight customers, and run smarter operations.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Engineer to own the systems, data and processes behind our go-to-market team. You'll own HubSpot and the revenue tool stack end to end, and personally build integrations, automations and AI-assisted workflows that help the team create and convert more effectively.

This is a builder role. The foundation is in place: a HubSpot Enterprise data model, ARR and renewal reporting, a MEDDPICC framework and an AI-assisted RevOps roadmap. Your job is to turn that into a planning, reporting and deal execution engine that leadership runs the business on.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own HubSpot Enterprise as the system of record: data model, pipelines, properties, automation, permissions and data quality.
* Own the revenue tool stack, including data enrichment, conversation intelligence, CPQ and e-signature, and make the tools work together through clean integrations.
* Write and maintain SOPs for how deals, renewals, handoffs and approvals move through the business.
* Find friction in the revenue process and fix it, with a bias toward automation and AI, measuring adoption, reliability, time saved and impact on pipeline or conversion.
* Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with sales leadership, and give reps dashboards and actionable account context.
* Partner with Finance on ARR, bookings and renewal reporting so the CRM and the books agree.
* Personally build and troubleshoot workflows using APIs, automation platforms and AI coding tools, partnering with AI Engineering Team on more complex projects and production reliability.
* Manage contractors and vendors to deliver system builds on time.
* Work with GTM team to turn customer conversations, account signals and won / lost deal patterns into better targeting, prioritization and relevant sales angles, acting as a strategic advisor to leadership on go-to-market design, pricing operations and growth levers.

**What You'll Own First**

* **Workflow automation, in Sales, Marketing and CS.** Build and maintain workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, follow-ups, and CRM updates, along with annual and quarterly planning process: territories, quota setting, capacity models and pipeline coverage targets, in partnership with the ELT.
* **Reporting and insights.** Streamline reporting into a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, ARR and renewals. Cut manual reporting and get leadership answers faster.
* **Contracting process.** Improve and automate end-to-end quote-to-contract workflow covering templates, approvals, e-signature and CRM handoff.
* **Deal desk.** Build approval workflows for pricing, discounting and non-standard terms, using thresholds and policies set by Finance and leadership.

**What We Need:**

* 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or GTM systems, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* A builder track record: you've personally built and maintained processes, integrations, systems and automated workflows from scratch, with evidence of adoption and measurable results.
* Hands-on CRM administration experience, comfortable building properties, workflows, reports and dashboards yourself.
* Experience writing SOPs and driving adoption of new processes across Sales, Marketing and CS.
* Experience integrating GTM tools through APIs and managing data flow between systems, including troubleshooting failures.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and automation platforms to ship working solutions, with the ability to write and debug code when needed.
* Working knowledge of SaaS metrics: ARR, net revenue retention, pipeline coverage, win rate and sales cycle.
* Firsthand experience learning from customer or sales conversations and using those insights to improve targeting, messaging or revenue workflows, along with quota, territory and capacity modeling.
* Clear communication with executives; you can turn messy data into a decision.

**Nice to have**

* Deep HubSpot experience across Sales Hub, Marketing Hub or Service Hub, especially at the Enterprise tier.
* Experience standing up a deal desk or contracting function.
* Exposure to multi-entity or multi-brand CRM environments.
* Familiarity with dropship, marketplace, ecommerce or supply chain software.

**Why Logicbroker:**

**Mission-Driven Culture:** Be part of a company transforming digital commerce through innovation and agility—your work directly shapes how global brands connect with customers.

**Collaborative, No-Ego Environment:** We believe the best ideas win, not the loudest voices. You’ll work alongside teammates who challenge and support each other.

**Flexibility with High-Performance Energy:** Whether remote or in-office, we foster autonomy and accountability—because we trust you to own your success.

**Leadership That Listens:** Our executives are not just accessible—they’re invested in your growth, open to your ideas, and committed to building a company where people thrive.

**Celebrated Wins, Shared Learnings:** From team offsites to Slack shoutouts, we celebrate progress and learn from setbacks together

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
125,000 - 130,000 USD per year(New York)

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. RIS uses a data-driven approach to design and implement street safety redesign projects, administer safety programs, promote senior and youth safety, manage crash data and data applications, conduct large-scale safety research projects, and lead agency action plans related to safety and Vision Zero programs/policy.
  
  
RIS’ Safety Projects and Programs team is seeking candidates for a Project Coordinator position. The candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, conducting outreach, and implementing Street Improvement Projects to improve safety for pedestrians, motor vehicles, bicyclists, transit riders, and motorcyclists, with a focus on the goals of the Streets Plan and Vision Zero. The position will focus on incorporating proven safety treatments to improve safety for all users as part of DOT’s commitment to Vision Zero and improving the safety, reliability, and accessibility of transit corridors.
  
  
Key tasks for this position include performing research and crash analysis to identify high crash locations, scoping and designing safety improvement projects for high crash locations, analyzing traffic data, preparing reports/graphics and maps, conducting field work including on-site evaluations and field meetings, coordinating project implementation, and providing technical assistance to senior staff. The selected candidates will also be required to participate in community outreach, including developing outreach plans and materials meetings with public officials, Community Boards, and inter- and intra-agency stakeholders. Colonial has provided a wide range of opportunities for job candidates who are highly qualified, skilled, motivated and team players. **Ready to work for Colonial Pipeline Company?**

Are you intrigued by the thought of being part of revolutionizing the energy industry and a new era in the pipeline industry? Colonial Pipeline is the largest refined products pipeline in the United States, transporting more than 100 million gallons or 2.5 million barrels per day. * Compile statistical and compliance reporting for Damage Prevention, Land Management, Public Awareness, Integrity Management, Tank Integrity, Corrosion Prevention, and other Asset Integrity activities.
* Support periodic departmental reports and annual system integrity and performance management reporting.
* Provide data and reporting support for risk management and analysis activities.

**Administrative & Business Continuity Support**

* Support recurring Asset Integrity budgets, funding approvals, and related administrative needs.

jobs.description:
Account Manager | Insurance & Financial Services

**Atlanta, GA | Full-Time | In-Office + Limited WFH**

Angie Sue Brown State Farm Agency opened in 2018 and is located right by Piedmont Park, where Midtown, Virginia-Highland, Ansley Park, and Morningside come together.

We’re a local insurance and financial services agency, but relationships are really at the center of what we do. We want our customers to know who we are, trust us, and feel like they have a real person they can call when they need help.

That same philosophy applies to our team.

We’re a small, close-knit office where your work matters and your contribution is noticed. We like to have fun, we support each other, and we genuinely enjoy the people we work with—but we also work hard.

**We want to be transparent about that from the beginning.**

This is not a position where you wait for work to come to you. You’ll have goals, make calls, follow up consistently, learn a lot, and be expected to contribute to the success of the agency. In return, you'll have the opportunity to earn more based on your performance, build valuable professional skills, and create a real career path for yourself.

**Help people make smart insurance decisions.**

You'll work with new customers to understand what they need and recommend coverage that makes sense for them. You'll have access to 100+ product options across auto, home, renters, life, health, business insurance, and more.

**Sell—and follow up.**

Sales is an important part of this role. You'll work active leads, talk with people who are already shopping for insurance, follow up with prospects, and ask for their business. There are monthly sales expectations, and we'll be upfront about what those are.

**Build relationships, not just quotes.**

We're not interested in winning someone's business solely because we're the cheapest option. We want customers who value having an agency and a team they can actually rely on. Your job is to help create that relationship from the first conversation and advise them on your recommendations.

**Learn an industry.**

You do NOT need to come to us knowing insurance. We'll teach you. What we can't teach as easily is curiosity, work ethic, accountability, and a willingness to learn. **Those are qualities you need to bring with you.**

**Get out into Atlanta.**

We're active in our community. You may join us at festivals, home shows, local events, referral visits, business partnerships, charitable initiatives, and other opportunities to meet the people and businesses around us.

* You're motivated by goals and like seeing the results of your work.
* You aren't afraid to pick up the phone.
* You can stay organized when there are a lot of things happening at once.
* You like people and genuinely enjoy helping them.
* You want feedback and opportunities to get better.
* You're comfortable being held accountable for your results.
* You enjoy being part of a small team where everyone contributes.
* You're looking for more than "just a job" and want somewhere you can grow.

* 1–3+ years of professional work experience
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Excellent phone presence
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and stay organized
* Self-motivated and comfortable working toward measurable goals
* Team-oriented and willing to jump in when needed
* Interested in continued personal and professional development
* Comfortable working in a small-office environment
* Ability to pass a background check
* Property & Casualty and Life & Health licenses—or willingness to obtain them before your start date

Interested in eventually owning a business yourself? Even better. For the right person, this role can be an opportunity to learn how a successful insurance agency operates from the inside and potentially prepare for agency ownership in the future.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**Location:** Atlanta, GA – in office

**Work From Home:** Two days per month after training

**After-hours/Saturdays:** Optional

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + commission

**Average Total Compensation:** $65,000–$95,000\*

**Benefits include:**

* 10 days PTO to start
* 401(k) with company match
* Life & disability benefits
* Teladoc health service
* $500 signing bonus
* Monthly promos to earn extra money or PTO
* Paid training and professional development
* Performance-based commission opportunities

**A note about compensation:** This is a sales-driven position, so total earnings will depend on individual performance. We believe in being transparent about expectations and earning potential throughout the interview process.

One More Thing

We're not looking for someone who checks every box perfectly.

We're looking for someone who is **dependable, motivated, coachable, good with people, and willing to work hard.** If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Angie Sue Brown State Farm Agency**

1440 Dutch Valley Pl NE, Unit 755

Atlanta, GA 30324

We have an exciting opportunity to join the U.S. SwiftRe® Team, part of the Global Facultative Market Unit at Swiss Re. SwiftRe® is Swiss Re's fully automated facultative submit/quote/bind platform for Commercial Property placements.

As a SwiftRe® Account Manager, you will focus on driving profitable premium growth through new business origination, strategic relationship development, and increased platform adoption. Working across broker and direct distribution channels, you will identify opportunities, expand market presence, and collaborate with underwriting and internal stakeholders to execute growth strategies.

**About the Team**

You will be part of a dynamic, entrepreneurial team focused on expanding SwiftRe®'s market presence and accelerating profitable growth through technology-enabled facultative reinsurance.

Our team values commercial initiative, collaboration, innovation, and accountability. We encourage individuals to take ownership of business opportunities, challenge conventional approaches, and contribute directly to the success of the platform.

You bring a strong commercial mindset with a passion for business development and origination. And your success is further enabled by your proactive, results-oriented approach to identifying and converting opportunities!

New client acquisition, increased submission activity, growth in bound premium, expanded platform utilization, and profitable portfolio development.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. This position is not eligible for full-time remote work and is not able to offer visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position in Alpharetta, GA and Chicago, IL is $108,000 to $162,000 and in New York, NY is $116,000 to $174,000. Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

**POSITION:** **Business Development Associate**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

AEI Consultants has a new career opportunity available for an entry to mid-level Business Development Associate to develop and maintain client relationships and pursue new business. The ideal candidate will be a recent graduate or have one to two years of previous sales experience and an interest in building a career in business development. The individual will eventually assume sales responsibilities for a large book of business.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The primary role will be to maintain and ground existing client accounts. Work with senior executives on maintaining and growing opportunities with existing clients while learning the aspects of the business
* Work with a local sales executive who will be a mentor and provide guidance in the sales process
* Work to price and prepare proposals for existing accounts
* Attend local networking events to obtain leads and meet with clients
* Maintain client satisfaction by understanding AEI's technical capabilities and client needs
* Develop new sales opportunities through cold calling, setting appointments and selling the value of AEI

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Approximately 1-2 years of previous sales experience in commercial real estate, environmental consulting, or a related field
* General understanding of commercial real estate markets
* Excellent communication skills
* Sales and goal-oriented
* Professional, high energy, self-starter
* Competitive attitude with demonstrated achievements in hitting goals
* Exemplary customer service and relationship management skills
* Ability to remain detail-oriented while working at a fast pace
* Ability to proactively develop client relationships utilizing cold calling techniques

**EDUCATION**

* BS or BA degree in Marketing, Sales, or a related field

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* The work environment may be both indoors and outdoors. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, type, handle office and/or field equipment, speak and hear. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, balance, kneel or crouch, and must be able to travel independently. The employee may be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to focus.

**EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & PERKS**

AEI Consultants offers all full-time employees an outstanding, extensive benefits package, which among other benefits includes medical, dental, and vision benefits, paid time off and sick leave, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 401K, complimentary use of AEI’s condo at Donner Lake in Truckee, CA, an Employee Referral Bonus Program, and Commuter Tax and Dependent Care Benefits.

**COMPANY CULTURE**

One of the primary reasons that our employees enjoy working at AEI is our positive company culture. We offer a collaborative, flexible and inclusive work environment where employees have the opportunity to engage in meaningful work, make a positive impact on our clients and communities, and are encouraged to carve out a career path within the organization that best aligns with their interests and goals. We greatly value the contributions of our team members and prioritize employee wellness, safety, flexibility and work/life balance.

**OVERVIEW**

AEI Consultants is an employee-owned consulting firm that provides comprehensive services to commercial lenders, property owners, managers, tenants, and developers, industries, institutions, government agencies, and insurers, including many Fortune 500 companies. These services include environmental, property and facility assessments, zoning and energy consulting, site investigation and remediation, industrial hygiene, land surveying, valuation, and construction risk management. AEI specializes in identifying potential risks and crafting solutions through Environmental and Building Evaluation Consulting, Construction Services, Site Investigation and Remediation expertise. AEI Consultants is known for being reliable, responsive and resourceful. Description:

**GardenCore** is seeking an experienced **Packaging & Print Production Coordinator** that provides the day-to-day administrative and workflow support required to move packaging from approved artwork through final production. The role serves as the central liaison among Marketing, packaging manufacturers, printers, local demand planners, Procurement, and other internal stakeholders. This position is responsible for maintaining accurate print-file records, coordinating new packaging orders and allocations, managing timelines and approvals, and performing final proof reviews before files are released for printing.

**Location:** This position will work onsite and will be located in **Peachtree Corners, GA.**

Requirements:

**Printer & Packaging Supplier Coordination**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day Marketing contact for packaging manufacturers, printers, prepress partners, and related production vendors.
* Coordinate artwork handoffs, proofing cycles, technical questions, production requirements, and final file release with external partners.
* Track vendor requests, open items, required decisions, and follow-up actions through completion.

**Print File Management & Archiving**

* Maintain an organized, accurate, and accessible library of current production-ready print files across bags, labels, cartons, displays, and other packaging formats.
* Archive and clearly identify obsolete or superseded files to prevent unintended use while preserving historical records.
* Maintain version control, approval status, effective dates, item references, printer specifications, and other supporting documentation for each file.
* Support periodic file audits to confirm that approved artwork and active production files remain aligned.

**Order Traffic, Demand Planning & Allocation**

* Partner with local demand planners and Procurement to traffic new bag and packaging orders from request through production.
* Coordinate order quantities, timing, site requirements, inventory needs, supplier lead times, and allocation priorities across locations.
* Escalate potential shortages, excess inventory exposure, conflicting requirements, or schedule risks early enough to support corrective action.

**Timeline & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain project timelines covering artwork development, internal review, vendor proofing, approval, production, and delivery.
* Communicate status, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and risks to internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive timely feedback and approvals by clarifying ownership, deadlines, and next steps for each project.
* Maintain a centralized project tracker and provide concise status updates to Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners.

**Proofing & Final Print Approval**

* Review final print files and vendor proofs for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved artwork.
* Verify critical production details such as item descriptions, UPC/GTIN information, claims, legal copy, colors, dimensions, dielines, printer marks, and version identifiers against approved source materials.
* Route final proofs to the appropriate subject-matter owners when specialized review is required.
* Document approvals and release final files for printing only after required reviews are complete.

**Core Deliverables**

* Accurate, current, and controlled print-file library with clear separation of active and obsolete files.
* On-time packaging order coordination and allocation support across plants and operating locations.
* Visible project timelines, status reporting, and escalation of risks or missing decisions.
* Complete proofing documentation and traceable final print approvals.
* Reduced risk of obsolete-file use, printing errors, production delays, and packaging-related supply disruption.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, supply chain, graphic communications, packaging, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.
* Experience in administrative coordination, print production, packaging, procurement, demand planning, project coordination, or a related environment.
* Strong document-control, records-management, proofreading, and version-control skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, and approval paths at the same time.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, especially Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and PowerPoint; experience with project-tracking or artwork-management systems is a plus.
* Working familiarity with packaging artwork, prepress, proofs, dielines, print specifications, UPC/GTIN data, and

* Short-term and long-term disability benefits

**Job Summary**

  

The Community Cats Program Specialist ensures community members have a clear, consistent path to PAWS Chicago’s Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR) services. Working within PAWS’s established strategies, the Specialist oversees day-to-day TNR operations in partnership with the Lurie Spay/Neuter Clinic, including scheduling, trap loans, eligibility, and data tracking. The Specialist also engages caretakers and community trappers through relationship-building, workshops, and educational resources. Bringing creativity and thoroughness to this work, the Specialist helps inform the implementation of strategy and operationalizes leadership decisions to maximize the clinic’s impact on outdoor cat populations in the communities we serve. The role also provides operational support to other Community Services programs and events as assigned.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Seamless access to TNR services
  + Coordinates TNR scheduling and appointment distribution through a single, consolidated channel in partnership with Clinic leadership and staff.
  + Oversees trap inventory and trap rental processes across PAWS and helps extend trap access into the community.
  + Plans and coordinates a full annual calendar of high-volume spay/neuter events with the Clinic.
  + Develops and maintains procedures and reference materials related to service eligibility, scheduling, and trap rentals, and partners with Clinic and Community Outreach leadership to train and inform operational staff on them.
* Community engagement and education
  + Serves as the primary TNR service liaison for community cat trappers, including recruiting, onboarding, and supporting volume trappers and managing their volume accounts.
  + Plans and coordinates TNR workshops, outdoor cat shelter builds, and other community events, and leads or facilitates them as needed.
  + Develops and maintains resources such as instructional and best-practice guides and drafts public communications.
  + Serves as a resource for caretakers and community members by phone, email, and web, including guidance on ordinance compliance and complex situations.
  + Engages, trains, and coordinates PAWS volunteers to support trap deliveries, cat pickups, and on-site trapping efforts.
* Program strategy, oversight, and data reporting
  + Contributes input to program goals, strategy, and service offerings alongside Community Services and Clinic leadership, and operationalizes leadership decisions.
  + Monitors TNR activity and trends against plan, and flags variances and escalates concerns to leadership.
  + Maintains accurate colony, caretaker, and service data across PAWS systems, and prepares recurring reports.
  + Contributes to the development of metrics and a model for evaluating program effectiveness.
  + Helps ensure PAWS meets its obligations as a Cook County Colony Caretaker Sponsoring Organization, including required records, reporting, and caretaker registration processes.

* Field and operational support
  + Participates in trapping and returning of outdoor cats and conducts site assessments as needed.
  + Supports other Community Services programs and events, such as off-site events, advocacy efforts, the pet food pantry, and CACC diversion, by filling frontline roles as assigned.

  

**Requirements**

  

* Two or more years of relevant experience (e.g., program coordination, operations, community outreach, or animal welfare).
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and thoroughness, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines and stay focused on priorities.
* Working proficiency in Excel or an equivalent tool for pulling, processing, and reporting data, and the ability to learn new database, scheduling, and CRM systems (such as Clinic HQ, Shelterluv, Salesforce, and Smartsheet).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including drafting clear public-facing communications that represent PAWS Chicago’s mission and values.
* Strong relationship-building and customer service skills, with a commitment to building trust with diverse communities and an understanding of the barriers residents may face in accessing care and resources.
* Ability to collaborate across teams and departments, including supporting work led by others.
* Ability to train and inform others and to facilitate group sessions such as workshops.
* Creative and practical approach to problem-solving, with the flexibility to adapt as priorities and direction change.
* Ability to work independently and remain professional in emotional or high-pressure situations.
* Passion for animals and working knowledge of animal welfare issues.
* Ability to work outdoors in varied weather and to lift and carry humane traps and equipment.
* Must be available to work pre-determined evening, weekend, and holiday hours.
* Current, valid driver’s license and the ability to travel throughout PAWS’s service area; comfortable driving cargo vehicles when needed for field work.

  

**Preferences**



* Bachelor’s degree.
* TNR or community cat experience.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish, or the ability to understand Spanish.
* Experience engaging or coordinating volunteers.
* Experience with program evaluation, data analysis, or reporting.
* Experience in community outreach, social services, or public health.
* Experience in an animal shelter, veterinary clinic, or similar animal welfare setting.

  

**Physical Requirements**

  

* The Community Cats Program Specialist must be able to physically handle cats with different temperaments.
* Ability to lift and transport cat traps and carriers.
* Physical stamina and ability to perform tasks that may require bending, lifting, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, and prolonged standing or walking.
* Walking and moving about to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.

jobs.title: Digital Content Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

As one of the fastest-growing on-the-go drinkware companies in America, we’ve got a reputation for doing great things. Our vision is simple - bring delight to eating and drinking.

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

We believe the right way to design products starts and ends with two key ingredients: process + people. Process is the path that takes us from ideas to products that are on brand, on time and on budget. People are the secret sauce that adds ingenuity every step of the way.

Together, we navigate each day with optimism, curiosity, a healthy sense of humor and a strong allergy to the word “no.” This desire for better, coupled with a deep understanding of consumers’ daily lives, gets us to meaningful delight.

**About the Role**

Do you love a well-run shoot almost as much as the final shot? Reporting to the Digital Content Producer, the Leapfrog Content Coordinator will keep our photo and video production running smoothly, from writing creative briefs and booking talent to tracking samples and checking every asset for color and detail before it goes out. You’ll work with teams across the company on product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retailer needs, and help grow our network of creative talent along the way. If you’re organized, detail-obsessed, and excited to help bring our brands to life across retail and digital channels, we’d love to meet you!

**What You’ll Do**

* Support production of photo and video content that aligns with brand messaging, marketing plans, and business objectives.
* Draft detailed creative briefs for photo and video shoots, ensuring alignment with brand vision, storytelling objectives, and campaign strategies.
* Maintain a well-organized production schedule for all shoots, tracking deadlines, asset delivery, and project milestones.
* Handle first outreach to photographers, videographers, or other vendors to check availability for upcoming shoots.
* Collaborate with the Sample Coordinator to ensure timely delivery of approved product samples for photo and video shoots.
* Complete first-pass edit reviews for digital assets including color accuracy against the physical sample, retouching notes, file specs, and naming conventions.
* Manage retailer-specific content requests and ensure assets meet partner deadlines and brand compliance standards.
* Work cross-functionally to prioritize production projects based on seasonal marketing campaigns, product launches, and retailer needs.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive list of creative vendors, continuously sourcing new talent to support evolving content needs.
* Ensure all assets are properly named, categorized, and stored for seamless cross-functional access.
* Stay up to date with industry best practices and emerging trends in photography, videography, and digital content.
* Occasional travel to off site shoots when needed.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Visual Communications, Journalism or related field preferred.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience in content production, creative operations, or marketing coordination, ideally in consumer products or retail.
* A sharp eye for visual detail, including color accuracy, image quality, and retouching needs.
* Highly detail-oriented and organized, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey ideas and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and working knowledge of digital asset specs, naming conventions, and file organization; DAM experience is a plus
* Experience in photo and video production, including conceptualizing shoots, coordinating with vendors, and overseeing post-production, is a strong advantage.

**Benefits at Leapfrog**

* 15 days Paid Time Off your first year, and an additional day each year thereafter (up to 25 days), as well as company paid sick days, holidays and parental leave options
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as commuter benefits and additional voluntary benefits
* Annual bonus payouts for all salaried employees, and up to a 5% 401k match with no vesting period
* Summer Fridays - from Memorial Day to Labor Day enjoy half days every Friday

Learn more about life at Leapfrog and our benefits by visiting us at www.leapfrogbrands.com

Leapfrog is currently operating under a hybrid work model, and this position will report on site to our Lincoln Park office at least 2 days per week. Additional ad-hoc in office days may be required based on business needs. Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with a hybrid work model.

**Salary Band**

$50,000-57,500, full-time, salaried, exempt, hybrid

Please note: Most candidates can expect to be positioned within the low to mid-range of the designated compensation band. This approach is designed to set realistic expectations while providing employees with the opportunity for growth and development within their roles. Placement toward the higher end of the band may be considered based on relevant experience, specialized skills, and other qualifications.

*Leapfrog Brands is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. jobs.description:
The Unit Sales Representative is responsible for supporting catering sales and event coordination for the Museum of Science and Industry in Chicago.

This position focuses on generating catering and event revenue, developing client relationships, coordinating event details, and ensuring an exceptional experience for corporate clients, private groups, nonprofit organizations, and other museum events.

**About the job**

Join a role where you’ll lead all aspects of conference center and catering sales, serving as the primary contact for clients seeking exceptional event experiences. You will guide clients through tailored recommendations based on event type, purpose, and timing while collaborating with Culinary and Catering teams to ensure flawless execution. This role combines sales, coordination, and client engagement to deliver memorable events that meet both client expectations and organizational goals.

The role of an individual contributor within the organization focuses on completing specific tasks and projects; contributing directly through their skills and expertise. Performs specialized technical tasks to support operations. Work is primarily achieved independently, however may collaborate with a team.

**Pay Range:** $29.67 per hour - $38.39 per hour

**What’s in it for you**

  

* Create memorable client experiences through expert event planning and execution.
* Collaborate with culinary and catering professionals to deliver seamless events.
* Manage diverse events from initial consultation to final follow-up.
* Develop and maintain budgets for the sales function and individual events.
* Build and maintain lasting client relationships to drive repeat business.
* Coordinate logistics and ensure alignment with client expectations and organizational standards.
* Professional growth in event sales, hospitality leadership, and operational excellence.

**What you’ll bring**

Previous experience in catering sales, hospitality, event coordination, food service, or customer account management preferred.

  

* Experience in conference center or catering sales and event coordination.
* Expertise in tailoring recommendations to client needs and event objectives.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills to manage multiple priorities.
* Proven track record in budget development and financial management.
* Client-focused mindset with attention to detail and follow-through.
* Collaborative approach to working with culinary and catering teams for seamless execution.

**Requirements**

* Education Requirement: Associate degree or equivalent experience
* Related Experience: 1 year

**What we offer**

Compensation is fair and equitable, partially determined by a candidate's education level or years of relevant experience. Salary offers are based on a candidate's specific criteria, like experience, skills, education, and training. Sodexo offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Care and Wellness Programs
* 401(k) Plan with Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* Career Growth Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement

More extensive information is provided to new employees upon hire.

**Who we are**

At Sodexo, our purpose is to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all. We believe in improving the quality of life for those we serve and contributing to the economic, social, and environmental progress in the communities where we operate. Sodexo partners with clients to provide a truly memorable experience for both customers and employees alike. We do this by providing food service, catering, facilities management, and other integrated solutions worldwide.

Our company values you for you; you will be treated fairly and with respect, and you can be yourself. You will have your ideas count and your opinions heard because we can be a stronger team when you’re happy at work. This is why we embrace diversity and inclusion as core values, fostering an environment where all employees are valued and respected. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to individuals regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, military status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need assistance with the application process, please complete this form.

**Department**

BFI - Events

**About the Department**

The Becker Friedman Institute for Economics (BFI) works with the Chicago Economics community to turn its evidence-based research into real-world impact. BFI takes a unique approach to bridging the divide between academic researchers and decision-makers in the business community and government by translating and packaging the rigorous work of the Chicago Economics community into accessible formats, and proactively sharing those findings with relevant decision-makers and thought leaders around the globe. BFI is a collaborative platform serving the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, the Kenneth C. Griffin Department of Economics, the Harris School of Public Policy, and the Law School. For more information visit https://bfi.uchicago.edu.

**Job Summary**

The Events Coordinator works closely with the Events Manager and Senior Manager, Events and Academic Programs at the Becker Friedman Institute for Economics (BFI) as a key member of the events team. This position provides professional support and plans logistics for a broad range of 80-130 events per academic year. These events include academic conferences, workshops, seminars, newsmaker events, summer programs and more.
  
  
Under general guidance, this role performs a broad range of operational business activities relating to the design, planning, and execution of events and programming.

* Assists with the coordination of events, including reserving space and hotel room blocks, coordinating with caterers, arranging transportation, setting up audio/visual equipment, tracking registration, providing updates of attendance to the team, and preparing event materials.

* Creates event registration pages and maintains guest lists.
* Assists with identification and resolution of event and program needs, including vendor selection and contract negotiation. Keeps track of all expenses, prepares reports on costs, using existing procedures to solve routine problems as they arise.
* Compiles data to be used in event and program evaluation. Contributes to improvements by implementing ideas as they are identified, with general direction from others.

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company:** Blooming Hearts ABA Therapy Center  
**Location:** Naperville, IL  
**Job Type:** Part-Time | Field-Based Outreach  
**Apply at**: info@bloomingheartsaba.com

**Job Description**

Blooming Hearts ABA Therapy Center is seeking a motivated and outgoing **Outreach Coordinator** to expand our professional referral network and generate new client referrals for our ABA therapy services.

The ideal candidate has strong communication and networking skills, with experience in healthcare, business development, or community outreach. Experience in ABA therapy, autism services, or pediatric healthcare is a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Visit pediatricians, hospitals, medical clinics, diagnostic centers, and other healthcare providers to establish referral relationships.
* Build connections with schools, daycares, psychologists, speech therapists, occupational therapists, and other autism-related service providers.
* Introduce Blooming Hearts ABA Therapy Center and its services to professional referral sources.
* Identify new referral opportunities and generate qualified leads.
* Maintain relationships with referral partners through regular visits and follow-ups.
* Track outreach activities, professional contacts, and referral leads.
* Provide weekly updates on outreach efforts and results.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in outreach, sales, or business development.
* Healthcare, ABA, autism services, or physician referral experience preferred.
* Strong communication, networking, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, organized, and results-driven.
* Reliable transportation for local outreach visits.
* Familiarity with Naperville and surrounding communities preferred.

Important

This is a **professional referral outreach position only**. The coordinator will work with healthcare providers, schools, and community organizations—not directly with clients or families. All referral activities must comply with applicable healthcare privacy and referral regulations.

What We Offer

* Flexible part-time schedule.
* Competitive pay based on experience.
* Supportive and growing healthcare organization.
* Opportunity for professional growth.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Naperville, IL 60564

The Junior Referral Marketing Coordinator is an entry-level, field-based role focused on building relationships with dental offices in your assigned territory. You will play a key role in supporting our marketing and outreach efforts by connecting with current and potential referral partners.

This position is ideal for someone looking to gain hands-on experience in relationship marketing, sales, and community outreach. Training and ongoing support will be provided.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Specialist- Central Region
jobs.description:
Marketing

If you are a current Duly/SBC/QMG employee, please apply through the Internal Career Site.

At Duly Health and Care, you are supported to do your best work and make a meaningful impact every day. You will be part of a collaborative, physician-led team that works as one and puts patients at the center of everything we do.  
  
With a connected network of providers, care teams, and services across primary and specialty care, surgery centers, imaging, lab, and therapy, you are part of a system designed to deliver high-quality, coordinated care. Together, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and help improve the experience and outcomes for every patient we serve.  
  
**Benefits:**  
  

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits that include healthcare navigation assistance.
* Access to a mental health benefit at no cost.
* Employer provided life and disability insurance.
* $5,250 Tuition Reimbursement per year.
* Immediate 401(k) match.
* 40 hours paid volunteer time off.
* A culture committed to community engagement and social impact.
* Up to 12 weeks parental leave at 100% pay and a financial benefit for adoption and surrogacy for non-physician team members once eligibility requirements are met.

  
The Field Marketing Specialist is a territory-based, field-facing growth role responsible for executing Duly Health and Care’s community engagement and patient acquisition activities throughout an assigned region. The position serves as the primary Duly representative at community events and is accountable for creating meaningful face-to-face engagement with prospective patients and families, generating qualified leads, converting event interactions into scheduled appointments, and nurturing leads through the CRM to drive completed patient appointments. The role owns the day-to-day execution of assigned community events, including event coordination, provider and staff communication, marketing materials, equipment, transportation, setup, onsite engagement, lead capture, appointment scheduling, and post-event follow-up. Success is measured through tangible growth outcomes, including leads generated per event, patient appointments, and new community partnerships.

**The position is highly field-based and requires regular travel throughout the assigned region, with the majority of event activity occurring during evenings and weekends.**

**Execute Community Events and Serve as Duly Field Representativ**e

o Coordinate and execute assigned community events, including logistics, staffing, materials, equipment, transportation, setup, and breakdown; ensure all required Duly and provider-specific collateral and supplies are available onsite.

o Serve as the primary Duly contact for event organizers and Duly providers and staff before, during, and after each event.

o Attend assigned events and actively engage attendees throughout the event to maximize Duly visibility, lead generation, and patient engagement.

**Lead Generation and Appointment Conversion**

o Engage prospective patients and families, identify opportunities for healthcare services, capture qualified leads in HubSpot in real time, and schedule appointments onsite whenever possible.

o Nurture and progress leads through established CRM workflows, coordinating timely follow-up to move prospects from initial engagement to scheduled appointments and completed encounters.

o Meet established performance expectations for lead generation, appointment activity, and patient encounters.

**Build and Maintain Community Partnerships**

o Identify new working relationships with community organizations, event coordinators, healthcare partners, schools, payors, senior organizations, and other local partners within the assigned territory.

o Represent Duly at community meetings, networking opportunities, health fairs, outreach events, and other community-based programs.

* Manage Lead Nurture, Reporting, and Performance Accountability – 15%

o Maintain accurate HubSpot records and event attribution and monitor leads through established stages, including outreach, scheduled, completed, and other applicable stages.

o Track and report event performance, including leads generated, appointments scheduled, completed encounters, no-shows/cancellations, and new partnerships; provide monthly reporting on results and ROI.

o Collect attendee feedback and event insights and capture approved event content to support patient experience improvements and Duly marketing communications.

**Coordinate Provider and Duly Staff Participation**

o Recruit, schedule, and confirm participating providers and Duly staff and communicate event details, arrival times, locations, parking, schedules, responsibilities, and expectations.

o Ensure providers and staff have the appropriate event information, materials, collateral, and logistical support needed for successful community engagement.

o Coordinate with Operations and other internal teams to address provider participation, location or departmental needs, and event-related requirements.

Level of Education - Bachelor’s degree

Field of Study : Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Healthcare Administration, or a related field

Years of Experience – 2-4 years

Experience in field sales, community outreach, business development, event marketing, healthcare outreach, customer acquisition, patient engagement, relationship development, or a comparable role involving direct, in-person engagement and measurable lead or customer outcomes.  
  
If you are committed to putting our patients first and helping shape the future of care, you belong at Duly.  
  
The compensation for this role includes a base pay range of $62,920.00 - $94,380.00, with the actual pay determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. Additional compensation may be available through shift differentials, bonuses, and other incentives. B

jobs.title: Ecommerce Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview of Position**

The Ecommerce Coordinator keeps our products accurate, visible, and easy to buy online, every single day. You will manage listings across several ecommerce platforms, build promotions, write product copy, and help turn our data into decisions.

This is not a typical direct-to-consumer ecommerce job. Online ordering here sits inside a larger business: it works alongside our sales team, our customer service staff, our physical locations, and an ERP that runs the whole operation. Many of our customers buy from us in more than one way. Your job is to make the online channel strengthen those relationships, not compete with them.

We are looking for someone who sees ecommerce as part of an ecosystem. You understand that a listing error can affect a sales rep's conversation, that a promotion has to make sense for inventory and margin, and that the best online experience is the one that makes the rest of the business work better.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Own the daily online presence of our products**

* Keep product listings accurate and current: pricing, availability, images, attributes, and categories.
* Audit listings regularly and fix errors before customers or sales staff find them.
* Launch new products and retire discontinued ones on schedule.

**Work across multiple ecommerce platforms**

* Manage our storefronts on Shopify and the other platforms we sell through.
* Learn new platforms quickly as our channels change, and document how each one works.
* Keep product information consistent across every channel.
* Build and run promotions
* Set up discounts, featured collections, bundles, and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate timing with purchasing, sales, and marketing so promotions match inventory and goals.
* Test every promotion before launch and confirm it performs as intended after.

**Write product copy**

* Write clear, accurate product titles and descriptions that help customers buy with confidence.
* Follow our brand voice and search best practices.
* Maintain copy standards and templates so listings stay consistent.

**Contribute to reporting and find opportunities**

* Pull and prepare regular reports on sales, traffic, conversion, and promotion results.
* Spot trends, gaps, and underperforming products, and recommend what to do about them.
* Share findings in plain language with teams outside ecommerce.

**Use NetSuite**

* Maintain item records and product data in NetSuite.
* Run saved searches and reports to support ecommerce work.
* Make sure data flows correctly between NetSuite and our ecommerce platforms, and troubleshoot when it doesn't.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 2+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience, managing product listings or storefront operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major ecommerce platform, and confidence learning new ones fast.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with spreadsheets, pivot tables, and reading dashboards.
* Clear, accurate writing, with an eye for detail in product copy and data.
* Experience setting up promotions, discounts, or campaigns on an ecommerce platform.
* An understanding of how ecommerce connects to sales, inventory, and customer service, not just marketing.
* Organized and dependable with recurring daily work, while juggling projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with people across departments, including those who don't work in ecommerce.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Shopify experience, including apps, collections, and discount setup.
* NetSuite experience, especially item records and saved searches.
* B2B, wholesale, or multi-channel ecommerce experience.
* Experience with seasonal, perishable, or fast-changing inventory.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar web analytics tools.
* Basic SEO knowledge and experience with bulk product imports (CSV).conversation.

jobs.title: Digital Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Move Your Career Forward with DAC as a Digital Media Coordinator**

**Who We Are**

We are DAC—a global full-funnel performance media agency dedicated to delivering transformative results. With expertise spanning SEO, paid media, creative production, analytics, and local optimization, we combine the brightest minds with innovative technology to deliver seamless, forward-thinking strategies. Powered by AI, data, and creative ingenuity, we deliver integrated campaigns that engage customers at every touchpoint—from global audiences to individual store locations.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Digital Media Coordinator to support the execution and optimization of paid search campaigns. This role is ideal for someone analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to develop expertise in digital performance marketing. The Digital Media Coordinator will assist with campaign setup, reporting, analysis, and optimization across platforms like Google Ads, Bing, and Facebook. We are looking for a motivated individual with strong Excel skills, a passion for data-driven marketing, and a hunger to learn and grow within a fast-paced agency environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Become an expert in biddable paid media (initially focusing on paid search, later adding paid social & display advertising skills).
* Produce weekly/monthly reports, covering all paid media channels & performance data.
* Work collaboratively, coordinate and communicate with internal and external partners.
* Provide ongoing analysis and monitoring of paid search & display campaigns with an eye to proactively expanding and improving campaigns based on client business needs.
* Build, launch, optimize and maintain paid search & display campaigns via Google Adwords, Bing, Yahoo, Facebook & other platforms.
* Conduct search ad copy & banner ad testing per best practice to drive performance improvements.
* Conduct keyword, placement & market research to make additions to new and existing campaigns.
* Perform QA on campaign set-up and post-campaign launch.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Completion of Google Fundamentals, Google Advanced, DoubleClick and Bing certifications is an asset
* Previous experience doing bulk uploads or using Google Ads Editor
* Demonstrate ability to build basic campaign structures on both engines
* Demonstrate the ability to pull reports and provide insights and observations on campaign performance at a high level
* Ability to review data and problem solve
* Expert ability to download data into Excel, perform VLookups, create Pivot Tables and charts
* Someone who is hungry to learn and wants to propel their career forward!

**What You’ll Get**

* **Professional Growth:** Work with top-tier clients and cutting-edge tools in the performance marketing industry.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Be part of a global organization that values curiosity, transparency, and innovation.
* **Competitive Benefits:**

  + Competitive salary and comprehensive health benefits.
  + Generous PTO, wellness initiatives and parental leave.
  + Retirement saving plans.
  + Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  + A supportive, collaborative, and casual work environment.

**How We Work**

This role requires three days in-office. Remote work is not available for this position.

If you require an accommodation in any aspect of the selection process, please reach out to tacquisition@dacgroup.com

Our offerings include health, vision, dental, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and employee assistance support. Full-time employees are eligible to participate in the DAC benefit programs.*

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $85,000 and $125,100/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $97,000 and $139,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offe
